sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2 official model card
sources.evidence: Exact V3.2 release, finetuned from DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-Base; describes DSA, reasoning and thinking with tools, text-token messages and MIT weights. Explicitly states V3.2 and Speciale have the same model structure as V3.2-Exp, while Speciale alone does not support tool calling.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2 release announcement, 2025-12-01
sources.evidence: Explicit dated December 1, 2025 launch: V3.2 succeeds V3.2-Exp and supports tool use in both thinking and non-thinking modes. Separately names Speciale and its restricted tool support.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models
sources.evidence: Section 2.1 says V3.2 uses exactly the V3.2-Exp architecture, with DSA the only architectural change from V3.1-Terminus. DSA combines a learned lightning indexer and top-k token selection over MLA. Section 4 reports a maximum supported context of 128K. This paper was downloaded and its full text extracted locally.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2 pinned checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: DeepseekV32ForCausalLM, 61 main layers, first 3 dense, 256 routed experts with 8 selected per token, 1 shared expert, 1 next-token-prediction layer, MLA dimensions, 64 indexer heads of dimension 128, top-2048 selection, FP8 block quantization and 163840 configured maximum positions.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2 tensor index and all 163 pinned safetensors headers
sources.evidence: All 92,425 indexed tensors matched all 163 bounded headers (11,941,929 header bytes). Raw 685,396,921,376 elements include 41,591,584 FP8 scales. Non-scale serialized entries: 685,355,329,792. Main: 671,877,944,064; MTP: 13,477,385,728. Removing documented shared MTP embedding/head copies, each 926,679,040 entries, gives 11,624,027,648 unique MTP and 683,501,971,712 complete unique parameters. Three 4096-byte samples per shared matrix pair matched; samples corroborate documented tying but do not establish whole-matrix byte equality. No whole weight shard was downloaded.

sources.title: V3.2 main final-normalization tensor, bounded range
sources.evidence: Retrieved only the 28,672-byte F32 payload for model.norm.weight (7168 values), in addition to the shard header; compared with the MTP shared_head.norm tensor from shard 163.

sources.title: V3.2 MTP final-normalization tensor, bounded range
sources.evidence: Retrieved only the 28,672-byte F32 payload for model.layers.61.shared_head.norm.weight (7168 values). It differs from the main final norm in 7166 scalar positions, so this exact checkpoint has distinct main/MTP output-normalization weights; its 7168 entries are retained, not deduplicated.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2 official inference implementation
sources.evidence: Defines the Transformer, MLA with learned DSA indexer, dense early MLPs, top-k MoE routing and shared experts. Router correction bias is nn.Parameter and remains in the tensor tally. FP8 scales are quantization state; caches are runtime buffers. The accompanying convert.py explicitly omits model.layers.61 for main-only inference.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 weight structure and sharing documentation
sources.evidence: Documents that the MTP embedding and output-head matrices share main-model parameters, and that weight_scale_inv holds quantization scales. Applied only through V3.2 paper and Terminus card explicit architecture links; no V3 numerical count is copied. V3.2 headers supply all numerical totals, and direct normalization comparison resolves the guide shared_head ambiguity.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus model structure statement
sources.evidence: Explicitly states Terminus has the same structure as DeepSeek-V3. Combined with the exact V3.2 paper stating DSA is its only architectural change, establishes applicability of the shared MTP matrix structure without transferring predecessor parameter counts.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4 technical report, Table 1
sources.evidence: Later first-party Table 1 labels the DeepSeek-V3.2-Base column and reports MoE, nominal 671B total and 37B activated parameters. This is a base-model comparison, not a direct instruct count. The nominal main active figure is supported for V3.2 by its explicit base/architecture linkage and identical base/instruct configuration; it is not an exact tensor-derived active total or a main-plus-MTP count.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-Base checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: This base model is named by exact V3.2 card metadata. Its full configuration is byte-identical to the V3.2 configuration, confirming unchanged layer dimensions, routed/shared expert counts and routing top-k, MLA/DSA structure, vocabulary and MTP depth after post-training.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2 MIT License
sources.evidence: MIT license file accessed from the pinned exact release; the model card explicitly applies MIT to the repository and model weights.

name.note: Baseline display spelling refers to exact DeepSeek-V3.2, distinct from Exp, Base and Speciale.

developer.note: Official DeepSeek release, checkpoint and license.

family.note: Catalog family key is consistent with explicitly documented DeepSeek-V3 lineage.

release_date.note: Primary release announcement explicitly labels the release date; day precision confirmed.

open_weights.note: Public official checkpoint index and all bounded tensor headers accessed.

license.note: MIT explicitly covers both repository code and model weights.

parameters_b.note: Derived complete unique learned-parameter count at pinned revision a7e62ac04ecb2c0a54d736dc46601c5606cf10a6: 671.877944064B main + 11.624027648B unique MTP = 683.501971712B. Excludes 0.041591584B quantization scales and 1.853358080B documented shared embedding/head copies; retains distinct MTP final norm and router correction parameters. The HF 685.355329792B non-scale serialized total still includes duplicate matrices. Nominal 671B main figures and stored 685B labels are different scopes, not this complete unique count.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal main-model active count, supported by the later DeepSeek-V4 report V3.2-Base column plus explicit exact V3.2 base lineage, same-architecture statement and byte-identical base/instruct configuration. Not an exact active tensor count, a count for Speciale only, or a combined main-plus-MTP speculative-decoding count. Header arithmetic with one input embedding row yields about 37.477B for an explicit main path convention; that convention is not substituted for the developer nominal 37B.

architecture.note: Decoder-only Transformer with MLA/DeepSeekMoE and DSA. The first 3 of 61 main layers have dense MLPs; remaining 58 have 256 routed experts, 8 selected, and 1 shared expert. DSA uses learned lightning indexers plus top-2048 attention-token selection. One additional MTP module is stored.

context_window.note: The exact technical report describes supported maximum context as 128K, represented here as nominal 128000 consistently with the baseline. Configuration max_position_embeddings=163840 is a separate positional ceiling, not evidence to replace the documented support limit.

modalities.note: Official text-token message encoding and causal language model; checkpoint architecture has no image/audio modality encoder.

reasoning.note: V3.2 supports thinking and non-thinking modes; this is the hybrid release, not reasoning-only Speciale.

tool_call.note: Exact V3.2 release explicitly supports tools in both thinking and non-thinking modes; Speciale restrictions do not apply.

description.value: Hybrid-reasoning DeepSeek model with thinking and non-thinking modes, sparse attention, and tool-use
description.note: Baseline description is supported and contains no unsupported performance comparison.

patch.notes: Complete unique checkpoint count derived from all 163 tensor headers: 683.501971712B = 671.877944064B main + 11.624027648B unique MTP. FP8 scale tensors and duplicated MTP embedding/output-head matrices are excluded; the MTP final normalization differs from the main norm and is retained. The 685.355329792B non-scale storage count includes duplicated shared matrices. The later first-party V3.2-Base comparison reports nominal 671B main/37B active; unchanged base/instruct architecture supports nominal 37B main active, not a full MTP speculative-decoding total. Supported context is advertised 128K; configured position capacity is 163840. Historical V3.2 release, distinct from V3.2-Exp and V3.2-Speciale and from current rolling API aliases.

summary: Verified complete unique total 683.501971712B using exact-release tensor headers, documented MTP tying and direct small-tensor evidence that main/MTP output norms differ. Added nominal 37B main active with explicit base/instruct architecture evidence and MoE/DSA architecture. Confirmed all other baseline factual fields, including 2025-12-01 release, MIT public weights, nominal 128K context, text modalities and tool use in both reasoning modes.
